en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: Animal genetics is the study of the hereditary units that make up animals. Students learn about the genes that influence physical characteristics in animals. In order to understand how animals inherit traits, you will study the workings of DNA and RNA molecules, how genes are expressed as physical characteristics, and the laboratory techniques used to analyse gene sequences. You will also study the mathematical principles employed in scientific breeding programmes, as well as mathematical models of how genes are distributed within a population.
